cardsServed: Chain Lightning; Ordnance Core; Soul Burst; Emergency Detonation

name: Multi-target spatial query

cardsServed: Static Build-up; Shockwave Belt; Chain Lightning; Ordnance Core; Hunter's Mark

name: Player distance accumulator
description: An odometer of player travel with a reset/consume rule

name: Ramp / charge accumulator with decay

name: Distance-scaled damage curve
